memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Here are the stages in the journey of the Israelites when they came out of Egypt by divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron. At the Lord's command Moses recorded the stages in their journey. This is their journey by stages: - Num 33:1-2 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Before the list of place names begins, we are told something important: "At the Lord's command Moses recorded the stages in their journey." God specifically wanted this travel diary written down. Every camp, every move, every wilderness stop was worth remembering. This was not idle record-keeping; it was God preserving the story of how He led His people, step by step, out of slavery and toward the land He had promised.

There is something deeply comforting in this. God cares about the journey, not just the destination. Every stage mattered to Him — the hard days in the desert, the places of testing, the times of rest. He was present in all of it, and He wanted His people to remember His faithfulness through the whole long road.

Your life is a journey too, and God is writing its story. The seasons you have passed through — the difficult stretches, the unexpected turns, the quiet ordinary days — none of them are wasted or forgotten in His sight. He has led you to this point, and He is not finished.

It is a wonderful habit to look back and record God's faithfulness in our own lives, so that we do not forget. When we remember how He has led us this far, we find courage for the road ahead. The same God who guided Israel through the wilderness leads His people still, and in Christ He has promised never to leave us on the journey home (Heb 13:5).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. When you look back over your life's journey, where do you see God's hand?
2. Do you tend to focus only on the destination and miss His presence in the journey?
3. How might recording God's faithfulness strengthen your faith?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful God, thank You that You have led me every step of the way and that no stage of my journey is forgotten by You. Help me to remember Your faithfulness and to trust You for the road ahead. Amen.
